_comment_model: Switch backbone here, then re-run: python setup.py --model <hf_id> [--device cuda]. Caches are per-(dataset,model), so 300M/600M/6B coexist.
_comment_dataset: HF dataset to use (default lamm-mit/silkome-masp, MaSp-only with its own train/test split; or lamm-mit/silkome-full). Switch here, then re-run: python setup.py.
_comment_split_mode: auto = use the dataset's own train/test split if it has one, else a harness grouped split; provided = always use the dataset's split; grouped = always pool+dedup and make a leakage-safe split grouped by property tuple (uses test_frac).
_comment_group_split: true = leakage-safe validation split grouped by fiber/property tuple; false = plain random val split
_note: These knobs are free for the autoresearch agent to tune. Architecture lives in model.py.
